visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with two neat pigtails stands in a sunlit indoor living room with light oak-colored wood flooring. She wears a white cotton T-shirt featuring a yellow cartoon duck and pink-and-white vertically striped shorts. Her small hands are fidgeting at her sides as she looks down thoughtfully. (2) The toddler moves toward a large white-framed glass sliding door that acts as a portal to a balcony. She reaches out with her right hand to touch the frame and glass, pressing her face close to see outside. The interior lighting is bright and even. (3) Turning away from the door, the girl looks toward the camera with a furrowed brow and pouts. She gestures with her hands, pointing downwards and then towards the door, clearly expressing a desire to move. The adult's legs are visible in the background. (4) She walks a few steps and grabs the hand of an adult woman who is wearing black shorts and brown slippers. The girl looks up at the adult with a pleading expression while holding her fingers tightly, attempting to pull her towards the glass door. (5) Now standing closer to the camera, the girl reaches both arms upward and forward, a universal gesture for wanting to be picked up or carried somewhere. Her expression is serious and determined. The background shows a minimalist home environment. (6) Returning to the glass door, the girl presses both palms and her forehead against the cool glass, looking out at the world. Overwhelmed by frustration, she begins to rub her eyes with her fists and her face scrunches up as she starts to cry. (7) The screen transitions to a solid pink background with a central cartoon illustration of the same toddler girl. Below the graphic, the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE' is displayed in a clean, white sans-serif font, serving as the video's outro.
